edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller permanent privileged control.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before committing the ownership change.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the untrusted caller.
transferFrom deducts allowed[from][msg.sender], trusting the caller as spender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
onlyOwner modifier restricts the arbitrary external ERC20 sweep to the owner.
Constructor writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
transferOwnership stages the privileged newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after transfer.
Parameter a feeds the unchecked-then-checked addition.
Parameter b feeds the addition.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction.
Parameter b feeds the subtraction.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication.
Parameter a feeds the division.
Parameter b feeds the division.
safeAdd executes the guarded addition operation.
safeSub executes the guarded subtraction operation.
safeMul executes the guarded multiplication operation.
safeDiv executes the guarded division operation.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on both the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender contract before returning success.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external token transfer call despite the onlyOwner guard.
receiveApproval is an attacker-controlled callback that re-enters the token contract.
The reentrant callback can re-read and mutate the allowance mapping before approveAndCall finishes.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.

Constructor writes symbol.
Constructor writes name.
Constructor writes decimals.
Constructor mints the fixed total supply.

_newOwner is written into the privileged newOwner slot.
